summary: Backend-only verification of the new Tennis 'Alt' market tab (iteration 29). 10/10 pytest tests passed. /api/picks/markets/Tennis returns the 4 expected tabs (Moneyline, Alt, Sets, Games O/U). /api/picks/today?sport=Tennis&market=tennis_alt returns 40 picks (10 spread-type like 'Svitolina -1.5 Games (Alt)' + 30 total-type like 'Over 16.5 Games (Alt)'), comfortably above the >=10 requirement. Tennis moneyline still serves picks (no regression). /api/version reports data_version='2026.06.23-tennis-alt-tab'. Code-level checks confirm SPORT_MARKETS['Tennis'] has the tennis_alt entry, _MARKET_REGEX['tennis_alt'] matches all the strings called out in the request, and SPORT_KEYS['Tennis'] now includes Eastbourne/Mallorca/Bad Homburg. MLB pitcher strikeouts endpoint still works. Midnight rollover safe: /api/picks/today returned 179 total picks.

minor.issue: backend.err.log shows recurring 'deep_dive failed ... unsupported operand type(s) for +: int and str' warnings during self-heal. Unrelated to tennis alt tab but worth tracking.
Repeated 429 rate-limits on /competitions/BSA/matches (60s back-off). Pre-existing soccer-source flakiness, not introduced this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: tennis_alt_q in /api/picks/today (server.py ~L1563) uses edge_percent>=-8 + lock>=70 — correct carve-out for chalk-ladder alt lines as described in the PRD. Verified to return 40 Tennis picks (well >=10).

_MARKET_REGEX['tennis_alt'] regex 'spread\b' is greedy enough to also match generic Spread markets across other sports; harmless because /picks/today already filters by sport=Tennis when querying, but worth keeping in mind if the regex ever gets reused.
server.py is now ~3854 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline and is overdue for modularization (out of scope for this iteration).
seed_data_creation: None. Existing picks dataset (288 generated by main agent's force-refresh) used for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tennis Alt tab is live and verified end-to-end on the public ingress URL. Use /app/backend/tests/test_tennis_alt_tab_iter29.py as a regression suite. BASE_URL is loaded from /app/frontend/.env (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Demo creds remain demo@lockscore.ai / demo123.
rca_of_issue: n/a — feature addition, no bug to RCA. All 10 backend tests green on first run.
